public_api.offset_semantics: Archive-absolute byte offsets for stream parsing/probing; member-local DSC byte offsets for decoding. None when no particular byte is responsible.

safety_and_semantics.index: Only the 16-byte header and index are read; stream EOF is obtained by seek/tell. max_index_size includes the header. No member payload or aggregate payload budget is charged. max_archive_size=None imposes no whole-archive size rejection. index_sha256 covers every byte in [0,index_end), including unused index fields, and is not a whole-archive SHA.
safety_and_semantics.members: A selected row must be the identical IndexEntry object in index.entries at its ordinal. The current stream size and selected range are revalidated. probe_member reads at most 0x220 bytes. read_member charges only stored size, never advertised DSC output. Stream positions are restored, including on errors; finite partial reads are supported, premature EOF is fatal.
safety_and_semantics.stream_identity_limit: ArchiveIndex is not an authentication token. Caller must retain the same unchanged seekable binary archive. Same-size content changes and concurrent writes are not detected. No member call rehashes the full index or payload.
safety_and_semantics.dsc_layout: 512 encrypted code lengths begin at 0x20; decrypt with (src-key_byte)&255, not XOR. uint32 seed/key arithmetic; MSB-first compressed bits begin at 0x220. Literals 0..255; match length=(symbol&255)+2 (2..257), distance=12-bit value+2 (2..4097).
safety_and_semantics.dsc_limits: Stored DSC input has a fixed 64 MiB ceiling; output capped by max_output_size. max_symbols caps declared symbols and bit-reading work to 32*max_symbols including distances; callers may explicitly increase it for unusually deep codes. Tree construction is bounded by 512 byte-sized depths and at most 1023 nodes, without recursion.
safety_and_semantics.dsc_strictness: Reject oversubscribed/incomplete trees except valid single depth-1 symbol. Permit all-zero tree only for empty output/count. Reject unused singleton branch, truncated literals/distances, backreferences before output start, output overrun/underrun and impossible count/length pairs. Require exact declared symbol count and output length. Only zero padding bits up to the next byte boundary are accepted; extra zero bytes or nonzero tail padding fail. Never return warning-only or partially decoded output.
unsupported: script disassembly/classification or proof that decoded bytes are script/text
safety_and_semantics.no_execution: No GUI, game execution, original-library runtime invocation, asset writes, paid API calls or external processes in the archive APIs.
